verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a managed business-services offering: incorporation, registered agent, compliance filings, bookkeeping with dedicated staff, mailroom and partner banking. Its core value is legal and human-delivered services rather than deployable software, so self-hosting it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable or open-source component that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
